scope: Second logic review fixes: CPU regression only; no new simulator or API benefit claim.

fixes.issue: Fresh HoloMotion observation statistics never updated
fixes.resolution: Update configured Actor/Critic EMA once per observed step after all PPO replay. Keep frozen Actor statistics frozen; save the mode and allow explicit legacy opt-in.
fixes.evidence: Counts remain 0 during rollout and optimizer replay, then become 12 after 3 environments x 4 steps; restored training reaches 24. Frozen evaluation leaves all persistent state unchanged.

fixes.issue: Teacher contact persistence used zero Student placeholders
fixes.resolution: Capture current privileged contacts and their mask separately. Quality admission uses current truth and requires both endpoints to be valid.
fixes.evidence: A constant-contact fixture rejects a 0.5-probability Teacher against the true persistence BCE of approximately 0.01005.

fixes.issue: Nonzero Dropout changed probabilities before any PPO update
fixes.resolution: Use eval mode in collection and PPO replay while retaining autograd for trainable parameters.
fixes.evidence: Both plain and Physics HoloMotion with 0.3 attention/MLP dropout pass pre-update probability replay checks and perform optimizer updates.

fixes.issue: Reordered motion libraries silently reassigned curriculum weights
fixes.resolution: Save ordered names and canonical motion-content hashes with weights; reject changed order, content or missing identity when resuming training.
fixes.evidence: Order changes, same-name content changes and legacy weighted packages without identity are rejected; matching-library resume still passes.

fixes.issue: Trial validation admitted a baseline modified by another new proposal
fixes.resolution: Record source and actual starting tuning snapshots, inherited advice and newly applied advice separately. Require an unchanged baseline and exactly the declared candidate change.
fixes.evidence: Different baseline proposals, changed initial settings and missing evidence are rejected. Shared inherited advice and float32 representation noise are accepted.

compatibility.legacy_normalization: Missing mode preserves prior frozen-statistics behavior. Use --observation-normalization update to explicitly enable the new behavior before collection.
compatibility.legacy_weighted_training: Resume requires verified motion identity; old weighted packages need a verified re-export. Frozen inference is unaffected.
compatibility.legacy_trial_reports: Missing training_trial evidence is rejected by the strengthened validator.
